description: Replace the whole field schema (draft; publish makes it live). Edit get_collection_schema's output; keys as list_collections gives them ("blog/" or an id). Field: { key, type, label?, help?, required?, unique?, inCard?, default? } — type text (multiline, minLength, maxLength) | number (min, max, integer) | boolean | option (options[] required) | multiOption (options[] required, max) | link | email | phone | color. Keys: letter then letters/digits/_ (≤40), not a built-in post field or secret-looking (author: text). ≤60 fields. settings.defaultSort: date:desc|date:asc|title:asc|slug:asc. Removing a collection drops its definitions (post values stay). Values go in put_post meta.custom. 400 invalid_collection_schema lists issues; 409 = stale ifMatch.

ifMatch.description: hash from get_collection_schema (stale → 409 conflict). null = the schema must not exist yet. Omit to write unconditionally.

name: put_collection_schema
